Demiurge Studios develops innovative games for console, PC, and mobile devices. The Associate Software Engineer will collaborate with engineers, artists, and designers to define, implement, test, debug, and maintain game systems and features while balancing scope, quality, and pace.

Work closely with artists and designers to understand and define game features and system requirements
Implement, test, debug and maintain source code

Collaborate with other engineers to develop and iterate on game features
Provide ongoing support to artists and designers
Make educated trade-offs among scope, quality and pace

Experience developing software in a professional environment
Experience developing software using agile methodologies
Experience developing games with the Unreal and/or Unity Game Engines
Experience working in C++ or C#
Experience developing apps or games for mobile or console platforms
